author: 3owj
content: L1: artifact folder-based session matching. Drop files in CPSC5001-09-03/ (or CPSC5001-09-03/day1/ etc) and they attach to that session. Qualifier derived from path within session dir (joined by -). Also fixed: PDF/PPTX were never registered by reconcile (TEXT_ARTIFACT_EXTENSIONS didn't include them), meaning workspace slide extraction was dead code. Renamed to ACCEPTED_ARTIFACT_EXTENSIONS, added pdf/pptx/ppt. classify_artifact_kind now returns Slides for those first. 6 new tests, scan_skips_binary_extensions flipped to scan_registers_pdf_as_slides.
